messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads up 1 QuantumWorks POC next week. They need SSO (SAML) + SCIM bulk import (~50k users) + RBAC sync. Two blockers: contractors send different NameID format; they want SCIM replace semantics at ~400 rps. Also want pricing guidance: Hosted vs Dedicated for sustained sync. @Rach @Lena

Rach (SE): Clarify issuer situation 1 same issuer with different NameIDs or different IdP issuers? If same issuer we can map claim transforms; otherwise alias table needed.

Alex (Prospect): Contractors come through a lightweight SAML proxy (different NameID format) but same enterprise Azure tenant. We'll try a CSV sample. Peak window about 10m, ~400 rps.

Diego (Eng): Implementation: we support idmap aliasing keyed by (issuer, subject)->internal_id. For SCIM bulk we recommend chunked uploads to our ingest endpoint which applies idempotent upserts. Example: curl -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/bulk-import -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@users.csv

Lena (Security): Security notes: SCIM bearer token rotation (hourly) needs validation. If they require BYO-KMS or HSM for keys + separate audit stream recommend Private. Throughput alone often leans Dedicated for cost predictability.

ops-bot: ticket POC-9912 created: "QuantumWorks SCIM ingest + NameID aliasing" assigned to eng-platform.

Sam (Sales): Can we sync Tue 10am PT? I'll invite QuantumWorks and attach security questionnaire. Rach will follow up with pricing bucket after ops reply.

Rach (SE): Ballpark: reserved Dedicated (S1 pool + burst) mid-five-figure USD/month depending on retention and SLA. Will confirm exact pricing with pricing-ops and post link.
